To. AHN KEONHO 

🦒: Keonho, hello. There’s something I’ve always wanted to tell you:
I’m really glad that you’re part of our team. Having you around makes me feel much more at ease. There are so many ways in which the two of us really click, and I tend to overthink things a lot, so it’s really nice to have someone like you by my side who understands me.
Whenever we feel like having fun, we can have fun together, and whenever we’re bored, we can always contact each other and make plans to go out. Having you guys by my side makes me feel truly happy.
Let’s make our lives even more fun together from now on.
We have to make our dreams come true too!
It would be great if, someday, we could live in a big house in LA and live together.
Everyone may want a different kind of life, but I’ve always loved the feeling of a lively home where there are always lots of people around.
If, in the future, the people you live with and our friends could all make music together, that would be even better.
You have to keep being with us too!
Thank you for everything, truly!

🦅: I’m really glad to have you. You’ve worked hard this past year, and you’ve truly put in so much effort and continued working hard. Let’s keep giving it our all from now on too! Let’s stand on even bigger stages together, let more people hear our music and see what we want to convey, and keep moving forward together!

🐢: You’ve worked hard always taking on the role of the maknae, and thank you for always being willing to listen to what I have to say. Thank you for being someone I can talk to comfortably. There will surely be difficult times in the future too, but no matter what happens, I hope you can get through it well and keep moving forward one step at a time. Fighting!!

🦊: Hello, Keonho.
Although we’re also the two who argue and bicker with each other the most, because you’re the only member in the team who is the same age as me, I feel like you’re also the member I’m most comfortable with and the one who feels most like a friend. I didn’t really go to school much before, so I never really had a particularly close friend. I’m truly grateful and fortunate to have someone like that in the same team. From now on, let’s continue living together just like we do now—comfortably, naturally, happily, and joyfully.

To. KIM JUHOON

🦒: Yo.
Thank you for always being willing to have deep conversations with me and for being honest with me.

Thank you, always. Let’s be good friends and brothers for the rest of our lives!

🦅: Roommate, thanks~ There are so many things I’m grateful to you for in our daily lives. First of all, I’m really lucky to have you as my roommate...
You’ve worked hard this past year, so let’s continue giving our all for our team. Let’s show the whole world a story that only we can tell and blow the roof off everywhere we go!

🦊: Hello, Juhoon hyung.
I think you’re a great hyung who makes it easy and comfortable to talk about things. I’m glad and grateful that you’ve been getting along so well with us and fitting in so naturally that it doesn’t feel like we’ve only known each other for a short time. Let’s do lots of fun things together in the future and keep working hard on music.

The other day, Seonghyeon and Martin hyung said they had to go somewhere else on their day off, so I was left alone. Thank you for watching a movie with me.

Terima kasih karena selalu bersedia berbicara dari hati ke hati denganku dan selalu jujur kepadaku.
Aku merasa sangat bahagia dan beruntung memiliki teman yang seumuran denganku di dalam tim, dan aku sangat bersyukur teman itu adalah kamu. Kamu selalu bersedia berbagi kekhawatiranku, jadi aku juga berharap bisa sedikit banyak membantumu dengan hal-hal yang kamu pikirkan. Kalau memang aku sudah bisa melakukannya, aku akan merasa lebih bahagia lagi.
Dalam waktu yang terasa singkat sekaligus panjang ini, kita telah melalui begitu banyak hal, dan masih ada perjalanan panjang yang harus kita lalui ke depannya. Aku selalu ingin mengatakan ini kepadamu: kamu benar-benar sudah bekerja keras. Bahkan sebelum kita sempat beradaptasi dengan semuanya, kita sudah berdiri berdampingan di atas panggung. Melihatmu diam-diam bekerja keras seperti itu, aku selalu ingin menyampaikan kata-kata ini kepadamu.
Terima kasih, selalu. Mari kita menjadi sahabat baik dan saudara seumur hidup!

🦅: Teman sekamar, terima kasih~ Ada begitu banyak hal dalam kehidupan sehari-hari yang membuatku berterima kasih kepadamu. Pertama-tama, aku benar-benar beruntung bisa menjadi teman sekamarmu...
Kamu sudah bekerja keras selama setahun ini, jadi ke depannya mari kita terus memberikan yang terbaik untuk tim kita. Mari kita tunjukkan kepada seluruh dunia sebuah cerita yang hanya bisa kita tampilkan, dan bikin semuanya heboh di mana pun kita berada!

🦊: Halo, Juhoon hyung.
Menurutku, kamu adalah hyung yang membuat orang merasa nyaman dan mudah untuk berbicara. Aku senang dan berterima kasih karena kamu bisa berbaur dengan kami dengan begitu baik dan begitu alami, sampai rasanya seperti kita sudah saling mengenal lebih lama daripada yang sebenarnya. Ke depannya, mari kita melakukan banyak hal menyenangkan bersama dan terus bekerja keras dalam bermusik.

🐶: Untuk Juhoon hyung,
Waktu itu, Seonghyeon dan Martin hyung bilang mereka harus pergi ke tempat lain saat hari libur, jadi aku ditinggal sendirian. Terima kasih sudah menonton film bersamaku.

To. JAMES

🦒: Thank you for always being a gentle and reliable hyung, and thank you for always being the creative force behind our team. Thanks to you, my perception of art always feels refreshed, and the way I look at things and my starting point have become different. Whether it’s movies, music, or fashion, I’m always positively influenced by you.
I hope the spark of your creativity never goes out in the future and continues to shine brightly. That’s James, at least in my eyes—that’s the kind of person you are. And please don’t try to carry everything on your own just because you’re the older brother. You can always tell me about anything that’s difficult or troubling you without feeling burdened. If there’s anything I can do to help you, I’ll always be willing to. Anyway, I’m truly grateful to you, hyung. Let’s stay together for a very, very long time in the future too.

🐢: Thank you for always letting me shower first after work, and thank you for telling me about so many good places to eat. It must sometimes be difficult being the only adult among us, but there isn’t much time left now. Difference.

🦊: Hello, James hyung. Thank you for always taking good care of me, looking out for me, and cooking for me since our trainee days. Since we started practicing together and sharing things with each other, I feel like I’ve grown so much and learned a lot. It probably isn’t always easy being the oldest while living with the younger members, but I’m glad that you seem to be adapting to us and still having fun. I’m happy about that. Let’s do our best from now on. Fighting.

🐶: James hyung, congratulations on our first anniversary. I think it must have taken you a long time to adjust after becoming a five-member team and meeting new people, but I’m very happy that we were able to debut together as CORTIS. Let’s keep fighting from now on too. I hope we can become closer and understand each other better.

I always act around you without holding back, and sometimes you might feel that I go a little too far, but thank you for accepting me with the generosity of an older brother.
Among the members, I’ve known you the longest, so I feel even more deeply about it, and I hope you’ll treat me the same way. Whether it’s in music or as your younger brother, you’re a hyung I can learn so much from, and I’m really glad that we’re on the same team. From now on, let’s happily make music together and walk this journey side by side.

🐶: To Martin hyung,
Hello, Martin hyung. I’m Keonho. Congratulations on our first anniversary, and I look forward to your continued support. As the leader, you’ll surely carry a lot of pressure and go through many difficult times in the future, but you don’t have to bear everything alone. Please feel free to tell me—I’m willing to listen. Keep fighting, and let’s make good music together.
➖️

Kamu sudah bekerja keras selama setahun ini, dan semoga kita terus tumbuh semakin besar dan berkembang seperti ini..! Jangan takut kehilangan orang lain. Takutlah kehilangan dirimu sendiri saat berusaha menyenangkan orang lain.

🐢: Terima kasih karena kita seumuran, dan terima kasih sudah mengajariku banyak hal yang tidak kuketahui. Masih banyak hal yang akan kita lalui ke depannya, tetapi mari terus semangat, dan aku harap kamu tidak kehilangan perasaan yang kamu miliki sekarang.

Aku selalu bersikap apa adanya di hadapanmu tanpa menahan diri, dan terkadang mungkin kamu merasa aku sedikit keterlaluan, tetapi terima kasih sudah menerimaku dengan kelapangan hati seorang kakak.
Di antara para member, akulah yang paling lama mengenalmu, jadi aku merasakannya lebih dalam, dan aku juga berharap kamu memperlakukanku dengan cara yang sama. Baik dalam hal musik maupun sebagai adikmu, kamu adalah hyung yang membuatku bisa belajar banyak hal, dan aku sangat bersyukur kita berada dalam satu tim. Mulai sekarang, mari dengan bahagia membuat musik bersama dan menjalani perjalanan ini berdampingan.

🐶: Untuk Martin hyung,
Halo, Martin hyung. Aku Geonho. Selamat atas ulang tahun pertama kita, dan mohon terus jaga kami ke depannya. Sebagai leader, kamu pasti akan memikul banyak tekanan dan mengalami banyak masa sulit di masa depan, tetapi kamu tidak perlu menanggung semuanya sendirian. Ceritakan saja kepadaku, aku bersedia mendengarkan. Terus semangat, dan mari membuat musik yang bagus bersama.
